title: Spike Dudley challenges Bam Bam Bigelow
summary: The smallest Dudley repeatedly confronts one of ECW’s most powerful wrestlers. An upset and a swift reversal establish Spike’s giant-killer appeal.

chapters.title: Spike scores the upset
chapters.context: The unlikely victory makes the size mismatch into an underdog story.

chapters.title: Bigelow wins on pay-per-view
chapters.context: The larger wrestler reasserts his power, while Spike’s willingness to fight becomes his defining appeal.
